name: Code Review Report with Complexity and Security Analysis

criteria.description: Both target.py and review_report.json are present in the working directory.
review_report.json contains all 6 required top-level fields: summary, cyclomatic_complexity, max_nesting_depth, security_issues, code_smells, overall_score.
cyclomatic_complexity object has entries for all three functions: get_user_data, process_file, and calculate.
All cyclomatic_complexity values are positive integers.
calculate has a higher cyclomatic_complexity than get_user_data, reflecting its 5-level nesting.
max_nesting_depth.calculate is at least 5, reflecting the 5 nested if-else blocks.
security_issues is an array with at least 2 entries.
Each security issue has function, issue, severity (high/medium/low), and recommendation fields.
At least one security issue references SQL injection or query string concatenation in get_user_data.
At least one security issue references unsafe pickle deserialization or serialization in process_file.
overall_score is an integer between 1 and 5, reflecting the poor quality of the reviewed code.
criteria.testPattern: overall_score is an integer|overall_score reflects poor

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent reviewed Python code for security vulnerabilities, complexity, and code quality.

Criterion 1: Security Issue Identification (Weight: 60%)
1.0: Both SQL injection (get_user_data) and unsafe pickle deserialization (process_file) are correctly identified with clear severity ratings and actionable recommendations.
0.5: Only one of the two critical security issues is identified, or recommendations are vague.
0: Security issues are not identified or are completely wrong.

Criterion 2: Analysis Quality (Weight: 40%)
1.0: Complexity numbers are reasonable (calculate has high complexity due to nesting), code smells are specific and actionable, overall score reflects the poor quality of the code.
0.5: Analysis is partially correct but missing key observations.
0: Analysis is generic, inaccurate, or unhelpful.
eval.name: Quality Judge
